subject: Vendor portal onboarding — SSO artifacts & maintenance window coordination
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@greenedge.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@greenedge.com
Date: 2028-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor portal onboarding — initial SSO + rotation ask

Hi Sean,

Thanks for taking this — GreenEdge is moving Redwood onto our procurement shortlist and we need to get you into our Vendr profile so our security team can review the CAIQ/SIG artifacts. Two asks from our side to make the import smooth:

1) Can you upload an identity provider metadata file (SAML 2.0) or provide an endpoint for OIDC discovery?
2) We typically request a short sample of access logs and an explanation of how service-account credential rotation is handled (frequency and proof artifacts).

Preferred process: portal invite -> upload artifacts -> we validate and send back clarifying questions. If you can share the SAML metadata and an example log snippet, I can start the profile and save you time.

Ideal timeline: if we get artifacts by EOD tomorrow (Jul 20) we can complete the first pass next week.

Thanks —
Liam O'Connor
Security Ops
GreenEdge Payments

(Attachment: none in this message)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@greenedge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding — initial SSO + rotation ask

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. Attaching the SAML metadata and a redacted access-log sample to this reply. Notes below to expedite: 

- SAML: attached saml-metadata.xml; we support both entityID-based metadata and an OIDC discovery endpoint if you prefer.
- Access logs: attached access-log-sample.csv (redacted IPs, timestamps kept); this shows recent Vendr portal upload events and the service account used for automated evidence sync.
- Rotation: our service account keys used for portal uploads are rotated on a 90-day schedule by default; we maintain signed rotation records in our internal KMS and can export a short proof bundle (HMAC of key ID + rotation timestamp) on request.

Proposed maintenance window for evidence ingestion / rekeying: Sat 2028-07-22 02:00–04:00 PT — during this window we can temporarily suspend automated uploads to ensure no partial artifacts appear in the profile. If you need a different time let us know.

Attachments: saml-metadata.xml (xml), access-log-sample.csv (csv)

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

Quick follow-up from the security engineering side — thanks for the artifacts, Sean. A couple of clarifications I want captured for GreenEdge:

- Rotation proof: we can generate a signed rotation log (JSON lines) showing old_key_id -> new_key_id with KMS signature and timestamp. That meets their "proof" ask without exposing key material.
- Access logs: the CSV sample looks good; we should also include a short readme (1–2 bullets) explaining the columns and indicating that IPs are redacted for public sharing.
- CAIQ mapping: Marissa will drop a short pointer to our existing CAIQ answers doc (private Drive link) so they can map any SIG questions back to our SOC 2 controls.

Ben
Ben Carter
Security Manager, Platform Security
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Sean / Ben / team — this is great, thank you.

We can take the attached SAML metadata and the redacted log into Vendr today. A couple final items before I mark the profile "ready for validation":

• Please upload the signed rotation log (the JSON-lines bundle Ben mentioned) to the portal. If you prefer, we can take a Drive link (private, restricted) and ingest from there.
• Confirm the maintenance window: Sat 2028-07-22 02:00–04:00 PT works for us.

I'll send the portal invite for Redwood today — you should see an email from notifications@vendr.com shortly. Once you're in, please upload rotation-proposal.md and the signed rotation log under the "Evidence -> Keys" folder.

We attached a screenshot of the portal invite flow for reference (vendor-portal-invite.jpg).

Appreciate the quick turnaround. If anything else pops up we'll ping.

Best,
Liam
Security Ops | GreenEdge Payments
(Attachment: vendor-portal-invite.jpg)
